note: AEGIS SaaS capability status projection (AS-25 / decision D33, plan §13.7). Per-claim displayed state plus the record that demonstrated it. The FIVE states are a closed vocabulary (see `states`); a claim reads `implemented_and_demonstrated` ONLY with a current, valid AEGIS TT-STG DONE record (vigil-aegis-tt-demonstration-v1, verified by engine/crucible/framework/v2/evidence/aegis_tt.py::verify_demonstration) whose id is named in `demonstrated_by`. No record, a stale record, or an invalid one reads `implemented_not_validated` — nothing can display `demonstrated` without a current IaC record. The drift guard (engine/crucible/framework/v2/evidence/tests/test_aegis_tt_demonstration.py) asserts every `state` is in the closed vocabulary and that no claim with a null `demonstrated_by` claims `implemented_and_demonstrated`. Records are produced by TT-STG runs (AS-1b) and the staging key is provisioned by AS-26; until then every claim here is honestly `implemented_not_validated`.
